law.name: Attention geometry admission
law.statement: Every record entering attention dispatch is admitted through the same geometry/authority contract the GML validator applies to parsed graph evidence.
law.order: collect -> admit_geometry -> dispatch -> rank -> (Ch'en verifies) -> (Xul commits)
law.boundary: Admission decides what may be projected. It never decides what is true: Ch'en verifies, XCFE authorizes, Xul commits.
law.mirrors: data/grammar/gml.validator.json — Q5/Q9 (finite geometry), Q13 (field kind), HE4/HE6 (interval class, projection-only authority), and the gml_before_geometry invariant in vectors.xml

inputs.vector: 3-component projection geometry (fold weight, relation weight, phase weight derive from it)
inputs.geometry_source: declared projection basis the vector comes from (gml_before_geometry)
inputs.interval_class: optional hyperbolic class; when declared it must match the interval sign
inputs.minkowski_interval: optional B(u,u); required to check a declared interval_class

statuses.Admitted: geometry finite, non-degenerate, source declared, no authority claim, interval coherent
statuses.GeometryNotFinite: a vector component is NaN or Inf (mirrors Q5 PARTIAL_VELOCITY_VECTOR / Q9 CURVE_PARAMETER_NOT_NUMERIC)
statuses.GeometryDegenerate: vector magnitude <= 1e-9: a zero vector cannot address a projection
statuses.GeometrySourceMissing: geometry_source is empty; geometry must name the basis it projects (gml_before_geometry)
statuses.GeometrySourceUnknown: geometry_source is not in geometry_sources — an undeclared basis is not admissible
statuses.AuthorityClaimed: the record claims semantic/topology/commit/verification authority (mirrors HE6)
statuses.IntervalClassInvalid: declared interval_class is not in interval_classes
statuses.IntervalClassMismatch: declared interval_class contradicts the sign of minkowski_interval (mirrors HE4)

invariants.AT1: no dispatch of a record whose geometry is non-finite or degenerate
invariants.AT2: no dispatch of a record that does not name its geometry source
invariants.AT3: no dispatch of a record that claims semantic, topology, commit or verification authority
invariants.AT4: no dispatch of a hyperbolic-typed record whose interval_class contradicts its interval
invariants.AT5: admission is projection-only: it can refuse geometry, never verify a fact
invariants.AT6: the collector applies admission itself, so every consumer shares it by construction
